@@U00034@@
The LORD. The HEAVENLY HOST. The three ARCHANGELS step forward.

@@U00036@@
The sun sings grandly, as of old, Joining with his brother spheres, Marching in his destined course, His thunders clap about their ears. The angels at his gaze grow strong, Though fathom it they never may; These works sublime survive forever As bright as on the primal day.

@@U00038@@
Swift, ah, swift, past understanding, The earth whirls ever onward! Mark! The radiance of that primal day Alternates with deepest dark. Behold, the sea’s broad billows surge From out its depths with primal force, Lashing rocks and crashing shore, With sun and stars in endless course.

@@U00040@@
Tempests rage in rivalry From sea to land, from land to sea, Forging from their raging furies A chain of mightiest energy. Lightning flashes its desolation With thunderous strokes along the way, But we, Lord, your angels, honor The gentle progress of your day.

@@U00042@@
The angels at your gaze grow strong, Though fathom you they never may;
translation:
@@U00034@@
耶和华啊。天上的主人。三位大天使向前迈步。

@@U00036@@
太阳一如既往地高声歌唱， 与他的兄弟天体汇合， 沿着他注定的路线行进， 他的雷霆在他们耳边拍打。天使在他的凝视下变得坚强，尽管他们永远无法理解；这些崇高的作品永远存在，像原始的日子一样明亮。

@@U00038@@
快，啊，快，超乎想象， 大地永远旋转！标记！那个原始日子的光辉与最深的黑暗交替。看哪，大海的波涛汹涌，从深处涌出原始的力量，鞭打岩石和破碎的海岸，太阳和星星在无尽的航程中。

@@U00040@@
风暴在竞争中肆虐，从海洋到陆地，从陆地到海洋，从它们的狂暴怒火中锻造出一条最强大的能量链。闪电沿途雷鸣般地闪过它的荒凉，但我们，主啊，你的天使，荣耀你这一天的温柔进展。

@@U00042@@
天使在你的注视下变得坚强， 尽管他们永远无法理解你；
